/* ClassMethod TestUnitNum() As %Status { #Dim pSource As EnsLib.HL7.Message set pSource = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Message).ImportFromString( "MSH|^~\&|INITIATE|IHC^900^L|Symphonia|UT000|201408202359||ADT^A08|201408210000010206|T|2.3"_$C(13,10)_ "EVN|A08|201408202359"_$C(13,10)_ "PID|||550690877^^^UA~550690877^^^UN~550690877^^^UB||ROUNDY^BRANDON^M|UNKNOWN|20080707|M|||7261 WESTPARK AVE^^MAGNA^UT^840442685^USA||||||||646045518||||||||"_$C(13,10)_ "PV1||I",.status) W status,! set pSource.DocType="2.3:ADT_A01" S sts = pSource.BuildMap() if 'sts {do $system.Status.DisplayError(sts)}
W pSource.GetValueAt("MSH:5.1",,.status) W "status "_status,! Set PID3Cnt = pSource.GetValueAt("PID:3(*)") W "PID3Cnt "_PID3Cnt,! ;Quit $$$OK Set UnitNum = "" for i=1:1:PID3Cnt { //Get Set aaNm = pSource.GetValueAt("PID:3("_i_").4.1") W "aaNm"_aaNm,! If aaNm = "UN" { Set UnitNum = pSource.GetValueAt("PID:3("_i_").1") Quit } } W "UnitNum "_UnitNum,! Quit $$$OK } */
